description: A request target has no fragment (MCPWARP.md §4.3): in origin-form `/mcp?a=1#x` the fragment is cut at the first `#`, before any URL is built, and dropped with everything after it, so the handler sees `/mcp?a=1`, never `%23x`. The absolute-form case is target_fragment_dropped_absolute_form.
in:
POST /mcp?a=1#x HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

28
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
0
notes: The edge never writes a fragment today (Go Request.Write drops it); the rule pins what an agent does if one arrives. ws-mixer-go before v0.9.0 escaped `#` as `%23`.
